turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, you're doing an awesome job of inspiring others with your journey. It's great to be part of it and see how you're positively affecting so many. turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks Mel! Your kind words mean a lot. Sharing our experiences isn't always easy, but I feel it's important to help promote understanding and acceptance. turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, Caroline! It takes courage to talk about our own stories. But it's in these vulnerable moments that we bond and understand each other. Thank you for using your voice to create love, acceptance, and hope. You're doing amazing!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! You've gained so much from your own experience. Your passion and hard work to help others is awesome. Keep it up, you're making a big impact!

turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Congrats Caroline! Good on you for going after what you really care about.
